svg.title: Where the money went
svg.desc: Waterfall decomposition of the momentum family's loss over 9,923 trades on $8.35 million of traded notional. The signal marked mid-to-mid, frictionlessly, earned plus $21.70 — 0.03 basis points, indistinguishable from zero and too small to be visible at this scale. The round-trip half-spread cost minus $6,939.02, giving a gross modelled result of minus $6,917.32. Fees cost a further minus $388.34, for a net of minus $7,305.66. The round-trip half-spread is 95 percent of the loss and fees are 5 percent.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where the money went — and it was not the signal

svg.text: The whole signal is the green hairline on the axis: +$21.70, or +0.03 bps of notional.

svg.text: The strategy was not wrong. It had nothing — and paid the spread 9,923 times to find that out.

svg.text: 95 % of the loss is the round-trip half-spread, 5 % is fees. Modelled P&L; no capital was ever at risk.
